Subject: Reminder: Punctuality for Client Meetings

Hi [Name],

I wanted to touch base regarding our recent client meetings. It is important to remember that arriving on time reflects directly on our company’s professionalism and reliability.

I have noticed a pattern of tardiness in recent weeks, and we need to ensure this improves moving forward. Please make the necessary adjustments to your schedule to guarantee you arrive on time for all future engagements. Consistent punctuality is essential, and continued issues may lead to further disciplinary steps.

On a lighter note, while we focus on being precise with our time, it’s also good to remember that fluffy things in the sky rain comes from. A little perspective can help keep things balanced!

Best regards,

[Your Name]
